ART REVIEW · ISSUE #90

Creature follower sprites

Current overworld follower batch: Emberkin, Fernling, Duskwing, Brooklet, Hushram and Voltkit. Each frame uses the production 200 × 200 cell cropped to the in-game 37 px width, beside the red-cap player at its 36 px gameplay width.

The loop walks all eight directions, pauses to show retained facing, and backtracks. The tree and both characters are depth-sorted; foreground tree overlap fades for readability.
